Same code here: $02:C656 compares the letters with $C66C and sets $341B = $FF, the decoder rejects BOMSOUND, the next valid code opens the sound test $02:C2A5 (I/II step $00-$39, Run plays, Select stops). code: Hi score hundreds digit 3, last attract demo not cut, hold Down+Run+Select+I+II as the 1P intro ends
effect: Special Select Room: scene, stage, bombs, fire and four power-up toggles
note: Already known for the 1990 card. The check $01:A001 is still called from $00:EA43, but only if mode $3380 = 0 and round $2849 != 8; the title always sets $3380 = 1 or 2 and $2849 = 8 ($01:A560/$A572), and $10 is only set by the attract-demo code in bank $0B, which nothing calls. So it cannot open in the shipped game. In Mesen with the password screen patched in, MUVWLNPC, $10 = 1, $2001 = 3 and the five buttons held, the room opened (and set $284D = 1, roller skate); $2001 = 4 or $10 = 0 did not (tools/pceub/test_select_room.lua)

code: Press Run on all five TurboTap pads on the same frame at PUSH RUN BUTTON
effect: Tap error screen even with a TurboTap connected
note: $01:A4DD calls $00:E30A when Run starts the title menu: it compares the new presses of the five ports ($220A-$220E) and sets $32 = 0 if all are equal, as they are with no tap. $08:6014 then jumps to the error screen $08:6EDE. Mesen with a TurboTap: Run on pad 1 alone or pad 4 alone gave $32 = 1 and the wins menu; Run on all five gave $32 = 0 and the error (tools/pceub/test_tap.lua)

effect: Any of the five pads drives the title and the battle menus
